keywords: 金条,金饰,金豆,账本,成本,工费,克重,纯度,保本,盈亏,日历,伦敦金,Au99.99,黄金温度,美债,小组件,攒金
description:
记下每一克，算清每一笔。

记金是一款黄金行情查看、个人持仓记录与回收盈亏估算工具。无须注册即可查看行情、记录本机持仓；选择使用 Apple 登录后，可将账户持仓和账本同步到服务端。

【看清行情】
查看国内 Au99.99 与国际伦敦金参考行情，按不同时间范围浏览走势、查价和区间统计。行情页面显示报价时间及数据口径；休市或停更时保留最后可用数据。

【记下成本】
记录克重、纯度、购入日期、金价、工费和其他费用；支持多账本、搜索筛选、部分卖出和赠送。用记金日历回看购入与处置记录。

【估算回收】
填写回收扣减、折价和固定费用，查看预计到手、盈亏、收益率及保本金价。盈亏来源拆解帮助理解成本和回收费用的影响，买前计算器与情景测算可用于比较自己的假设。

【日常工具】
应用内汇集多种实用工具，方便日常使用。

【自己掌握数据】
游客记录保存在设备中，只有主动导入后才会上传至登录账户。账户支持退出与注销；多设备修改发生冲突时，可明确选择保留的版本。

说明：行情为参考数据，可能存在延迟或暂停，不代表品牌零售价或实际回收报价。所有测算均为估算，不提供黄金买卖、交易撮合或投资建议。目标提醒仅在 App 打开且位于前台、取得有效行情并获通知授权时检查，不保证锁屏或退出期间实时触发。
reviewNotes:
Jijin (记金) is a free personal gold holdings journal and recovery estimation tool. Version 1.0.5 (build 60) delivers the following updates on top of 1.0.4:
1. Redesigned the "Me" (我的) and "Settings" (设置) pages with a dark-gold visual style, adding a personal gold-saving profile summary, one-tap privacy masking, and a compact 5-state icon-only cloud sync status indicator next to the username.
2. Added a 3-page dark-gold onboarding guide for first-time users and a "3-Step Quick Start" (3 步开启记金) checklist card on the Holdings (持有) tab to help users get started smoothly.
3. Improved Market (行情) session status copy with clearer closed/break/settled labels, and enhanced holding purchase markers on intraday and historical charts with temporary end-point anchoring during closed or unsettled sessions plus out-of-viewport indicators.
4. Refined bottom action bar layout and keyboard dismissal behavior when the numeric keypad appears in holding entry forms, and refreshed App Store screenshots.

Review paths:
- Without signing in: All core features — including the onboarding guide, Market quotes & charts, adding/editing local sample holdings via the bottom-right "+" button, Holdings & 3-Step Quick Start card, calculation breakdown, Calendar, Me/Settings privacy mask, and Home/Lock Screen widgets — can be reviewed directly in guest mode with no account required.
- Cloud sync (optional): Tap 我的 > 登录 / 注册 and sign in with Sign in with Apple to test cloud backup and sync status indicators.

Disclaimer: All market quotes, macroeconomic references, and recovery calculations are objective reference tools for personal record-keeping only. The app does not execute trades, sell gold, offer brokerage services, or provide personalized investment advice.

The App Store screenshots illustrate the market, holdings, calculation breakdown, and calendar features using sample holdings.
